title: LLM Entry (normative record schema)
description: Schema for LLM-generated dictionary entries: one record per lexical entry with one sense per CEDICT gloss (used for llm_generated.json)

pinyin.description: Pinyin echoed from CC-CEDICT (never model-generated): tone numbers plus the source's own punctuation — ',' multi-reading separator, ':' u:/ü convention, '·' transliterated-name separator. Only control characters are rejected.

senses.description: One sense per CEDICT gloss; the set of source_gloss values must equal the CC-CEDICT gloss set for the entry (accept/reject criterion)

source_gloss.description: The individual CEDICT English gloss this definition was generated for

definition.description: Generated definition for this gloss, in the target language

llm_model.description: LLM model and version used for generation

prompt_version.description: Version identifier for the prompt template used
